# Cancel stops a run while its agent works. status shows the run as cancelled.
! exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &
waitfile started

exec obee cancel 7
wait

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tcancelled$'

# A second cancel has nothing to stop.
! exec obee cancel 7
stderr 'nothing to cancel'

! grep '^implement' calls.log

-- hang --
plan
-- verdicts --
approve
